text:
leigh (Eng): Need help  my elective gallbladder surgery was denied as not preauthorized and billed out-of-network. I thought the surgeon was in-network. Claim/denial#: 998822334. Attached: denial letter, EOB, surgeon portal screenshot.

sam (People Ops): Oof. Which plan are you on and did the surgery get scheduled through a hospital system or independent surgeon?

leigh (Eng): Redwood Select HSA (RW-HSA-2025). Surgery scheduled through Starlight Surgical Center; surgeon page shows in-network on UnitedCare directory. I paid deposit and got a denial after the procedure.

benefits-bot: Plan: RW-HSA-2025 (UnitedCare Select). Note: elective inpatient/ambulatory surgeries often require prior authorization for certain CPT codes. Directory snapshot (2025-06-18): Dr. Harris, Starlight Surgical Center  In-Network. Prior auth rules: see https://unitedcare.example/preauth. Appeals/Retro auth contact: 1-800-555-9012.

sam (People Ops): Two likely scenarios: 1) preauth required and wasn't obtained by the surgeon/hospital; 2) the selected CPT required a specialty authorization or different authorization route. We'll open an appeal and ask for retroactive authorization. Can you attach the operative report and the booking confirmation?

leigh (Eng): Uploaded denial.pdf, eob.pdf, booking_confirm.png, op_report.pdf. The op report lists CPT 47562.

oliver (Broker): I can escalate this with UnitedCare and request retroactive authorization for CPT 47562. UnitedCare sometimes approves retro auth when surgery is medically necessary; we'll submit clinical notes + op report. If denied, provider may need to resubmit with authorization code. I'll open broker case and push for reimbursement.

nina (Finance): If you covered the billed amount out-of-pocket, Finance can offer a temporary advance while the appeal is pending. DM me the amount and receipt.

leigh (Eng): Thanks  please cc me on the broker case. Also is there a short appeal text I should paste into the UnitedCare portal when I file?

sam (People Ops): Paste this into UnitedCare portal or tell the rep: 

"""
To UnitedCare Member Services,

Please review the denial for Claim/Denial #998822334 for services dated 2025-06-16 (CPT 47562) at Starlight Surgical Center by Dr. Harris. The procedure was scheduled through the in-network facility and provider listed in the UnitedCare directory. The claim was denied for lack of prior authorization. Attached: operative report, booking confirmation, pre-op notes, EOB. We request retroactive authorization and reprocessing under in-network benefits.

Member: leigh (Eng)
Plan: Redwood Select HSA (RW-HSA-2025)
Member ID: [redacted]

Thank you,
[Member Name]
"""

benefits-bot: UnitedCare appeal initiated: UCARE-2025-0618-1044. Broker escalated: HB-ESC-1122. Sam logged internal HR ticket HR-BEN-781.

leigh (Eng): Appreciate everyone. I'll DM Nina if I need the advance and will wait for the broker/insurer update. :pray:
